summary: Gate of requests (i55, q21): 10 questions from the round-1 gate.md.
questions: requests r14 (work status observations). Lines concerned: r14 (existing, unchanged text in spec/), possibly retired; replacement r59 would read: "When `work list` is run, `work` shall print, with its date, each observation that the `source` of no initiative and of no request names." The delegation says r14 is retired with work status, but no accepted line retires it. Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) retire r14 and add r59 as worded; (b) retire r14, no replacement; (c) keep r14.

supervision r186 vs r149 (word for word the same). r186 (added): "When a round of the kind `formulate` formulates nothing because a capability-proposal's answers change lines not in `spec/`, `work run` shall start a new round of the kind `integrate` for the capability-proposal." Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) retire r149, keep r186, so a work-item is drafted for the fault i39 met; (b) drop r186, keep r149; (c) keep both. r152 and r153 do not conflict and stay.

supervision r184 vs r32, r81, r9. r184 (added): "When `work run` ends with a capability-proposal or a work-item `awaiting-answer`, `work run` shall exit with an error, printing each with its open questions." r184 covers r32 and conflicts with r9 when every work-item is done while a capability-proposal is `awaiting-answer`. Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) retire r32 and r9, adding r187: "When no node of the initiative can make a transition, every work-item is `green` or `withdrawn`, no capability-proposal is `awaiting-answer` and no request whose asker is this context is in the asker's turn, `work run` shall exit successfully, printing each work-item's status."; (b) keep r32 and r9, r184 taking precedence; (c) keep r32 and r184, retire r9 only. r81 stays (recommended) or also prints each proposal's open questions.

supervision r184, exit code. Drafted as "exit with an error" under design-decision/exits-are-successful-or-errors, the code (3) being held by Implementation: "3 awaiting an answer". Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) as drafted, the code in Implementation only; (b) add an Implementation line "r184: the exit code is 3".

work-queue r47 vs r23, and supervision r105 (done set with no condition on capability-proposals). r47 (added): "If every work-item of an initiative is `green` or `withdrawn` while one of its capability-proposals is neither `formulated` nor `withdrawn`, then `work` shall keep the initiative `started`." Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) retire work-queue r23 for r48: "When a `work` command's change makes it true that an initiative has at least one work-item that is `green`, that every work-item of it is `green` or `withdrawn`, that every capability-proposal of it is `formulated` or `withdrawn` and that every request kept in this context whose asker is this context and that names the initiative is `delivered`, that command shall set the initiative's status to `done`." and retire supervision r105 for the same condition as r188; (b) keep r23 and r105, r47 the exception; (c) change only r23.

work-queue r47, `merged` proposals. r47: "If every work-item of an initiative is `green` or `withdrawn` while one of its capability-proposals is neither `formulated` nor `withdrawn`, then `work` shall keep the initiative `started`." Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) as drafted, word for word; (b) "neither `formulated`, `merged` nor `withdrawn`".

supervision r185 vs r132/r131. r185 (added): "When a researcher's result gives an empty file set, `work run` shall take it as the researcher's file set." Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) keep r132 and r131, r185 beside them; (b) retire r132 for "a researcher's file set, empty or not" and drop r185. An empty planner's file set: (a, RECOMMENDED) nothing drafted; (b) add r189: "When a planner's result gives an empty file set, `work run` shall take it as the planner's file set."

requests r50 vs work-queue r34 (`work list` already prints requests with status). r50 (added, replaces r13): "When `work list` is run, `work` shall print each request with its status and whose turn it is." Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) keep both; (b) fold r50 into r34 (retire r34).

requests r52, "on either side". r52 (added): "While an answer or a turn the asker has sent has not been taken in by the upstream, `work show <request>` shall print the request on either side as awaiting the upstream and not yet taken in." Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) `work show <request>` run in the asker's and in the upstream's repository both print it; (b) shown as awaiting on both sides of its turn. `--json` for "not yet taken in": (a, RECOMMENDED) nothing drafted.

requests r55 vs r16. r55 (added, replaces r34): "If a side writes a part of a request that is the other side's part, and the request's asker is not the upstream itself, then `work` shall refuse, naming the side that writes that part, and change nothing." r55 exempts a request whose asker is the upstream itself; r16 has no exemption. Readings: (a, RECOMMENDED) keep r16; (b) retire r16 for a line with the same exception.
